title.zh: 豁免福特基金会及其赠款缴纳赠与税、特许经营税、特定税、百分比税、不动产税及所有其他税费，并豁免参与福特基金会项目的外籍人员缴纳所得税
title.en: An Act to Exempt the Ford Foundation and its Grants from the Payment of Gift, Franchise, Specific, Percentage, Real Property, and All Other Taxes, Duties and Fees and to Exempt Foreign Personnel Engaged in the Ford Foundation Program from the Payment of Income Tax
title.orig: An Act to Exempt the Ford Foundation and its Grants from the Payment of Gift, Franchise, Specific, Percentage, Real Property, and All Other Taxes, Duties and Fees and to Exempt Foreign Personnel Engaged in the Ford Foundation Program from the Payment of Income Tax

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1963/ra_3538_1963.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The provisions of existing laws or ordinances to the contrary notwithstanding, the Ford Foundation shall be exempt from the payment of gift, franchise, specific, percentage, real property and all other taxes, duties and fees provided under existing laws or ordinances. This exemption shall extend to goods imported under the Ford Foundation grants for scientific, educational and training purposes to government organizations and private institutions recognized by the government and to goods brought in or imported for the personal use of foreign personnel whose services are paid by the Ford Foundation, or from funds granted by the Ford Foundation: Provided, However, That this exemption is without prejudice to the collection of customs duties and taxes on goods or articles brought or imported into the Philippines for the use of such foreign personnel should such goods or articles subsequently be sold, transferred or exchanged in the Philippines to persons or entities not entitled to exemption from said customs duties and taxes pursuant to existing laws and regulations governing the matter.

Non-Filipino citizens serving on the staff of the Ford Foundation grants shall be exempted from the payment of income tax on salaries and stipends in dollars received solely and by reason of service rendered under the Ford Foundation program.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 20, 1963.
